section_summary: This section opens with correspondence about the Bank of Taiwan, Yokohama Specie Bank assets, and proposals for American commercial banking in Japan and Korea. Filing memoranda then introduce a July 1946 Bank of Japan statistical monthly. Its tables cover banking, credit, bonds, securities, prices, postal savings, and insurance.

subfiles.title: Telegram concerning the Bank of Taiwan and a new proposal
subfiles.to: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, Tokyo
subfiles.about: Requests a report on the Bank of Taiwan's liquidation and notes a forthcoming proposal from Christelow.
subfiles.summary: Seeks SCAP's findings on Japanese depositors' assets and says a proposal including textiles will follow.

subfiles.title: Yokohama Specie Bank funds in neutral countries
subfiles.about: Calls for a full account of Yokohama Specie Bank funds abroad and their relationship to Japanese government funds.
subfiles.summary: Silver urges prompt investigation of bank assets in neutral countries, especially Switzerland, for a contemplated revolving fund. He notes claims concerning money intended for prisoners of war and internees and asks that transfers, receipts, and related records be traced.

subfiles.title: Draft cable on American and foreign banking in Japan and Korea
subfiles.about: Forwards a combined draft cable on American banking facilities and foreign bank operations.
subfiles.summary: Requests concurrence on a draft cable addressing National City Bank's proposed role in handling Japanese export dollars.

subfiles.title: Approval memorandum on American commercial banking facilities
subfiles.about: Recommends approval of a draft cable seeking SCAP's views on American bank operations in Japan and Korea.
subfiles.summary: Explains National City Bank's proposed services and Chase National Bank's branch request, and seeks SCAP's assessment of banking needs.

subfiles.title: Storage of Japanese bank statements
subfiles.about: Requests overflow storage for Japanese bank statements and related materials.
subfiles.summary: Asks MacMahon to store bank statements because Strong's office has limited space.

subfiles.title: Additional Bank of Japan statements for storage
subfiles.about: Sends additional Bank of Japan statements for storage with earlier materials.
subfiles.summary: Directs that attached statements be stored with the previously filed material.

subfiles.title: Financial Statistics Monthly, No. 4, July 1946
subfiles.about: Compiles Japanese financial and banking statistics in tables, graphs, and price indices.
subfiles.summary: The monthly opens with contents and a graph of Bank of Japan note issues and nationwide bank deposits and loans. Tables report assets and liabilities of banks, trusts, cooperatives, lending institutions, the Deposit Bureau, and insurers, alongside securities transactions, government bonds, debentures, capital, postal savings, and Tokyo price indices. The excerpt ends partway through the insurance-company tables.
